title: Protesters confront JD Vance on family ski trip to Vermont
description: Many of the protesters turned in support of Ukraine after Vance and President Trump signaled support for Russia on Friday.

title: UK's Starmer says Europe is at ‘crossroads in history’ as leaders agree to steps to Ukraine peace
description: LONDON (AP) — British Prime Minister Keir Starmer rallied his European counterparts Sunday to shore up their borders and throw their full weight behind Ukraine as he announced outlines of a plan to end Russia’s war.
